{{Current events|year=2022|month=02|day=10|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]]
**[[Belarus–Russia relations]]
***[[Russia]] and [[Belarus]] begin a 10-day military drill exercise known as Allied Resolve-2022 amidst ongoing tensions with [[Ukraine]]. The [[United States]] and [[NATO]] denounce the exercise, with NATO calling it the biggest deployment of Russian troops since the [[Cold War]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2022/02/10/russia-set-to-begin-massive-military-drills-with-belarus.html (CNBC)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] lifts its outdoor [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask mandate]] that is in place since before [[Christmas]] as the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron variant]] declines. [https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/news/world/821508/spain-drops-outdoor-mask-requirement/story/ (GMA News Network)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Charles, Prince of Wales]], tests positive for [[COVID-19]] for a second time. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/uks-prince-charles-tests-positive-covid-19-second-time-2022-02-10/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Western Australia]]
****[[Western Australia]] reports a record 37 local cases from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, out of 139 new cases. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-02-10/wa-records-37-new-local-covid-19-cases-plus-102-travellers/100818880 (ABC News Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia]]
****The [[Australian Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation]] proposes changing the definition of fully vaccinated people to those who have received a booster shot. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-02-10/fully-covid-vaccinated-two-doses-atagi-advice/100821406 (ABC News Australia)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Costa Rica]]
***[[Costa Rica]]n [[President of Costa Rica|president]] [[Carlos Alvarado Quesada]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/americas/costa-rican-president-tests-positive-for-covid-19/2499445 (Anadolu Agency)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
***[[Tunisia]] lifts its nightly [[curfew]] as COVID-19 cases decline, but ban of gatherings has been extended for further week. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/tunisia-lifts-covid-related-night-curfew-government (''National Post'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Xenophobia and racism related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**A [[South Korea]]n envoy in [[New York City]] is attacked in an unprovoked assault. His injuries are not critical. [https://news.yahoo.com/south-korean-diplomat-attacked-york-171610395.html (Yahoo! News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Archaeologists]] announce the discovery of a single [[Human tooth|tooth]] in the ''Grotte Mandrin'' near [[Malataverne]], [[France]], dating to 54,000 [[Before Present|YBP]], around 10,000 years before the currently accepted date for the arrival of ''[[Homo sapiens]]'' in [[Europe]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/02/09/europe/tooth-human-neanderthal-france-cave-scn/index.html (CNN)]
